description: This file defines the SsoToken class within the AWS SDK for PHP, representing tokens obtained via AWS SSO. It includes properties and methods related to token management, expiration, and instantiation from token data.

classes.name: SsoToken
classes.description: Represents an SSO token from AWS SSO provider, extending the base Token class, with additional properties specific to SSO tokens like refresh token, client ID/secret, and region.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the token has expired based on expiration timestamp and registration expiration.

methods.name: getRefreshToken
methods.description: Returns the refresh token if available.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the client ID associated with the token.

methods.name: getClientSecret
methods.description: Returns the client secret associated with the token.

methods.name: getRegion
methods.description: Returns the AWS region associated with the token.

methods.name: fromTokenData
methods.description: Creates an SsoToken instance from given token data array.
